description: React component for displaying detailed view of an MCP server, including overview, tools, and settings; supports editing and copying info.

classes.name: MCPServerViewProps
classes.description: Props interface for MCPServerView component, including server data, user info, and callbacks.

methods.name: handleSuccess
methods.description: Callback to handle successful server updates, resets editing state and navigates back.

methods.name: renderUrlWithToggle
methods.description: Returns either full or masked URL based on toggle state and token presence.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies given text to clipboard and updates UI state with success indication.
